# Simple Custom Post Order 2.9.1

A small follow-up to 2.9.0. How orders are saved is unchanged.

- **The opt-in *Parent / child* setting now explains the URL change.** Moving a
  published page under another page changes its address, and WordPress does not
  redirect the old one, so links to it need updating. (A nested category's old
  archive URL keeps working.) The feature remains off unless you switch it on.
- **WordPress Plugin Check reports no errors.** The remaining reports were checks
  the tool could not follow: the plugin's own table, column and savepoint names,
  and integers printed through `%d`. They are now written so the tool can verify
  them, without changing any SQL sent to the database.

## Testing

The test suites no longer depend on the original development site and now cover
parent dragging (22 regression and 24 browser checks). The full regression,
transaction, compatibility, HTTP and Chrome suites pass on WordPress 6.2 with
PHP 7.4 through WordPress 7.2 RC3 with PHP 8.6, on MariaDB 11 and MySQL 8.4,
with a Redis object cache, with WooCommerce, and on a multisite subsite as a
site administrator.
